title: UI: held or unknown hand-off rows without a delivery receipt render no card or Cancel but count as waiting
outcome: A queued row the backend will not run (engram_ordinary_handoff from the H5 load rule, or a promoted legacy-retained row kept as history) is shown as an unknown hand-off with a Cancel control and is excluded from the actionable waiting count.
acceptance: UI: held or unknown hand-off rows without a delivery receipt render no card or Cancel but count as waiting is done
